claim_boundary: Exact identity and obstruction audit. No RH proof; the all-place intersection identity and independent positivity remain open.

exact_results.statement: For dim(V)=2, e_T(A)=Tr(A)I/2 is idempotent, trace-complementary, Hilbert--Schmidt self-adjoint and conjugation-equivariant.
V tensor V=Sym^2(V) plus wedge^2(V), and End(V)=Q(0) plus Ad^0(V), isolate one scalar zeta factor after the weight-four shift.
exact_results.scope: Exact good-place identity; classical global factorization.

exact_results.statement: The symmetric-square prime coefficient is a_p^2-p^3. The expression a_p^2-2p^3 omits the middle eigenvalue alpha_p beta_p.
The identity endomorphism is inertia-fixed at p=2, so the Tate line contributes (1-2^(-u))^(-1).
exact_results.scope: Scalar Tate factor only; the full ramified adjoint factor is not reconstructed.

exact_results.statement: The completed Tate factor is 2 xi(u)/(u(u-1)), not xi(u); determinant formulas must retain the pole normalization.

obstructions.statement: The scalar Q(0) image contains no level-8, Calabi--Yau, f8 or E8/H8-specific data. Projective representation data that survive in End(V) lie in the adjoint complement; scalar-twist, sign and realization data may be lost altogether.
obstructions.consequence: The projector identifies the zeta factor but supplies no new positivity mechanism.

obstructions.statement: A linear map from an infinite Weil test space to a fixed finite carrier has a kernel, so any pulled-back positive carrier form vanishes on a nonzero source direction.
obstructions.external_premise: Zhu's arXiv:2608.24827v2 preprint supplies a certified strict compact-window Weil-positivity premise; this repository does not re-prove it.
obstructions.consequence: Conditional on the external strict-floor premise, one fixed finite E8, H8, Calabi--Yau, End(H3), code or quantum carrier cannot represent the complete window Weil form as an exact linear pullback. Nonlinear methods, growing finite families, direct limits and finite discretizations are not excluded.

obstructions.statement: Nonnegative A(X)=O(X^q) does not imply b_n=O(n^(q-1+eps)); a finite maximum K fitted and tested on one window is tautological.
obstructions.counterexample: b_n=4n^3+1_{n=32^m}n^(18/5) preserves A(X)~X^4 and the simple s=4 pole but violates n^(31/10).
obstructions.historical_note: Rankin 1939 uses a quantitative summatory error term, not a pole/main term alone.

solution_contract.requirement: Global absolute curve with all finite places, infinity, scaling/Frobenius and explicit p=2 treatment.
All-place square with a well-defined Arakelov or height intersection product.
Linear continuous injective map from a dense Weil test class to primitive or degree-zero correspondences.
solution_contract.constraint: In this exact-linear formulation the image must be infinite-dimensional or supplied by an unbounded compatible/direct-limit family.

solution_contract.requirement: One exact local-to-global pairing producing all prime-power, gamma, log-pi and pole terms.
Independent global polarization or Hodge-index inequality on the entire image.
Density, closure and convergence transfer to the complete Weil test class.
solution_contract.note: TFPT form convergence is available; the positivity premise remains open.

solution_contract.requirement: Regularized determinant or trace identity including pole normalization, conductors, epsilon factors, p=2 and infinity.
solution_contract.note: Local scalar Tate bookkeeping is exact; the global identity is open.

first_missing_theorems: Tate--Weil realization: construct a zero-independent all-place family D_f whose intersection pairing is the polarized Weil form.
Absolute Hodge index: prove the required sign on the full image independently of zeta zeros.
sources: Andre Weil, Sur les formules explicites de la theorie des nombres premiers, Commun. Sem. Math. Univ. Lund, Tome supplementaire (1952), 252--265
